notes.title: DPS Idle 2 is available in early access!
notes.content:
The second part of the DPS Idle game, DPS Idle 2, is finally available for download!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402710/

The game has been released in early access. Now we are actively working on the game and on the feedback from players.

notes.title: Added a special offer/quest
notes.content:
Added a special offer/quest (in the quest menu). This offer will appear if you complete other quests.

If such offers will work well, then in the future we may add similar "quests" related to other YDKR games or games of YDKR team members. So stay tuned :)

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
